authorized_scope: Design and record a training plan on new G histories; no GPU launch or full bank generation in this turn.
question: Can a history-only learned CV residual reduce error on the same actual frozen-W3-G cache, without worsening temporal quality?

producer.cache_representation: existing dense state, no new FK projection
producer.identity_rule: Match actual frozen producer data/statistics/bootstrap identity; preliminary planning digest is not interchangeable.

model.initialization: random trunk and zero residual head; initial P equals CV
model.inputs: body states up to t-1 and reconstructed/bootstrap flags only
model.output: current frame t, one 0.1s step after last history frame

history_distribution.W1: optional final producer generalization diagnostic, not training or selection gate

train_inventory.scope: Metadata counts only, not a full data re-audit.

train_context.start: fixed seed2062 keyed by source, uniform integer in [0,T-context_len]
train_context.startup: head-only neutral first20 local frames, then uninterrupted frozen-G online rollout
train_context.L: actual previous G calls in local context; query=20+L; Lmax=context_len-21
train_context.mature_queries: local>=40, at least20 actual G calls
train_context.early_selection: deterministic without replacement among valid candidates; L-uniformity is soft because short sources cannot supply all L
train_context.mature_selection: unique evenly spaced valid L from20 to Lmax, include both endpoints when at least2 anchors
train_context.samples_extracted: before current G call, using actual cached states including previous W3 rewrites
train_context.production_noise: existing query/slot-keyed noise seed1062; episode key includes context identity

bank_identity.bind_manifest: producer native identity, no substituted preliminary digest
bank_identity.split_manifest_rule: Store producer training manifest separately from each bank split manifest; val/train hashes are not required to be identical.

data.storage: Banks, checkpoints and logs in project directory; official dataset remains on data disk.
data.full_source_bank_does_not_mean: all motion frames traversed or every bank row visited during2k pilot

sampling.hierarchy: within each phase, uniformly take -> eligible source/context -> anchor
sampling.missing_phase_source: exclude from that phase pool, retain in valid phase; never silently change48:16 quota

loss.code: 243-dimensional normalized weighted MSE; channels198:207 weight8; hand PCA included
loss.geometry: own predicted-beta FK body22 against current official GT joints, scale0.1m
loss.CV_geometry: CV own beta for main comparison, never GT beta

geometry_calibration.formula: min(0.03, 0.1 * norm(mean code gradient) / norm(mean geometry gradient))
geometry_calibration.initial_zero_head_caveat: initial gradients mainly reach output head; monitor later full gradients, not an all-training guarantee

optimization.resume: Keep optimizer, EMA, scheduler, CPU/CUDA RNG and sampler counters; initial stop_after2000 does not change max-step identity.
optimization.budget_rationale: Engineering screening cap, not an epoch-equivalent or convergence guarantee; stage2k prevents committing full budget without trend.

evaluation.selection: D128 mature query40..79 clip-equal MPJPE, EMA only
evaluation.main_comparison: P and CV on identical cache before current G call; no P feedback or own rollout in this standalone test.
evaluation.temporal_rule: Only adjacent dense anchors with actual dt; no sparse-anchor differencing. Mature temporal metrics use stencils fully inside the mature group.

paired_CI.aggregation: paired clip means; resample take clusters and maintain clip-equal means

evaluation.supplemental_shape: use same CV beta for P and CV to separate shape and dynamics
evaluation.independence_statement: D128 is part of D400; shared-take long50 also not independent test. Preserve original lists; report a D128-take-excluded supplement.

pilot_2000.failure: Stop at2k, diagnose by phase/part/shape/gradient/coverage. Any changed method uses new P02 identity, no automatic extra steps.

final_predictor.if_still_improving_at_cap: budget complete, training sufficiency unconfirmed; no auto extension
final_predictor.interpretation: Minimum stage-entry criteria, not a paper contribution or proof of final-G gains.

gates.system_gain: Only later same-baseG/equal-additional-G-budget CV vs P adaptation, then new-model fusion diagnostic, can establish final reconstruction usefulness.

preparation_required.task: predicted-beta FK for P training, P/CV evaluation and bank baseline fields
pure new-G mode; W3-only producer validation; phase/take/source/anchor quotas and actual visit coverage
source/context builder up to160 frames, local-L semantics, bank producer identity validation
dense clip-equal evaluation, mature selection and paired take-cluster CI
learning-rate scheduler and stateful resume with unchanged10k identity
small-bank causality/CV equivalence/beta gradients; real4GPU interrupted-vs-continuous preflight across shortened LR boundary
freeze implementation, generate train/D128 banks; train-only calibration and measured G/P throughput before any ETA

downstream_order: Equal-budget CV/P G adaptation from same newG, recipe separately finalized
New P/G oracle fusion and error correlation diagnostics
If evidence supports, freeze P/G and train causal U with CV+U vs P+U controls
Separate FFT-loss controls after initial P/U tests, combine only after independent gain

review.independent_plan_review: review_preparation: no blocking logical issue; require local-L semantics, per-phase eligible pools, actual visitation coverage, and validation overlap disclosure
review.reason: Planning/documentation changes only, implementation preflight remains pending.
review.corrected_issue: Temporal5% guards apply to BOTH mature and all groups at pilot, D400 and long50; not selectable after results.
